ipxact:addressBlock.ipxact:name: uart_wrap
ipxact:addressBlock.ipxact:description: Wrapper address map instantiating the per-UART log-engine blocks.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: uart_log_engine_wrap
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:displayName: UART Log Engine Wrapper Address Map
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Composes the UART 16550 core, log engine, and their control registers for one UART instance.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: uart_log_engine_ctrl
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:displayName: UART Log Engine Control Address Map
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Top-level enable register for the UART log-engine block.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: UART_EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: UART Enable. When set, the pad-mux downstream will be forced to accept UART traffic.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: uart
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Contains the mode-independent registers and the read-only registers accessible only when `DLAB = 0`.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DATA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Received Data. Contains a received character. If FIFOs are enabled, this field points to the bottom of the RX FIFO. Otherwise, this field points to a single- byte Receiver Buffer Register.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ERBFI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable Receiver Buffer Full (Received Data Ready) Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ETBEI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable Transmitter Buffer Empty (Transmitter Holding Register Empty) Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ELSI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable (Receiver) Line Status Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: EDSSI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable (Delta Status of) Modem Status Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: EFEI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable FIFO Error Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: INTERRUPT_PENDING
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Interrupt Pending. Active-low.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: INTERRUPT_ID
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Interrupt ID: * `0x7` - FIFO Error Interrupt (priority 0) * `0x3` - Receiver Line Status Interrupt (priority 1) * `0x6` - Reception Timeout Interrupt (priority 2) * `0x2` - Received Data Ready Interrupt (priority 3) * `0x1` - Transmitter Holding Register Empty Interrupt (priority 4) * `0x0` - Modem Status Interrupt (priority 5)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FIFOS_ENABLED
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: FIFOs Enabled: * `0x0` - FIFOs are disabled * `0x3` - FIFOs are enabled

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: WLS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Word Length Select: * `0x0` - 5 bits per character * `0x1` - 6 bits per character * `0x2` - 7 bits per character * `0x3` - 8 bits per character

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STB
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Stop Bits: * `0` - 1 stop bit. * `1` - 2 stop bits (or 1.5 stop bits if word length is set to 5 bits)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: PEN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Parity Enable.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: EPS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Even Parity Select: * `1` - even parity * `0` - odd parity

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STICK_PARITY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Stick Parity. If set, forces the transmit and received parity bits to be `0` if even parity is selected and `1` if odd parity is selected.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SET_BREAK
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Set Break. If set, forces the `tx_o` output to `0` to cause a break condition on the receiving UART.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DLAB
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Divisor Latch Access Bit. If set, allows access to the `DLL` and `DLM` registers when accessing addresses `0x0` and `0x4`, respectively. If unset, allows access to the `THR`, `RBR`, and `IIR` registers.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DTR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Data Terminal Ready. Writing to this bit drives the `dtr_no` output in the opposite polarity.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RTS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Request to Send. Writing to this bit drives the `rts_no` output in the opposite polarity.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: OUT1
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: User Output 1. Writing to this bit drives the `out1_no` in the opposite polarity.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: OUT2
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: User Output 2. Writing to this bit drives the `out2_no` in the opposite polarity.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOOP
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: System Loopback. If set, the transmitter is internally connected to the receiver. The `tx_o` output is set to `1`.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LINE_LOOPBACK
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Line Loopback. If set, the `rx_i` input is internally connected to the `tx_o` output.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Data Ready. When set, indicates that the RX FIFO (or RBR in non-FIFO mode) contains data.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: OE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Overrun Error. When set, indicates that the RX FIFO (or Receiver Buffer Register in Non-FIFO Mode) is full when new character is received. In FIFO Mode, the new character is dropped. In non-FIFO mode, the existing character in the RBR is overwritten. This bit triggers the Receiver Line Status Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: PE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Parity Error. When set, indicates that the character at the top of the receiver FIFO (or RBR in non-FIFO mode) has a parity error. This bit triggers the Receiver Line Status Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Framing Error. When set, indicates that the received character is missing a stop bit. In FIFO mode, this bit is set when the character reaches the top of the FIFO. In non-FIFO mode, this bit is set when the character enters the RBR. This bit triggers the Receiver Line Status Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Break Interrupt. When set, indicates that the `rx_i` input is `0` for an entire frame's time (start + data + parity + stop bits). In FIFO mode, this bit set when the character reaches the top of the receiver FIFO. In non-FIFO mode, this bit is set when the character enters the RBR. This bit triggers the Receiver Line Status Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: THRE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Transmitter Holding Register Empty. When set, indicates that the TX FIFO (or THR in non-FIFO mode) is empty. Clearing the Transmitter Holding Register Empty Interrupt does NOT clear this bit.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TEMT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Transmitter Empty. When set, indicates that the transmitter shift register and the transmitter FIFO (or THR in non-FIFO mode) are empty.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ERROR_IN_RCVR_FIFO
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Error in Receiver FIFO. When set, indicates that the receiver FIFO or (RBR in non-FIFO mode) has the parity, framing, or break error. In other words, at least one of the PE, FE, and BI bits is set.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DCTS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Delta Clear to Send. When set, indicates that the `CTS` bit has changed since the last time this register was read. This bit triggers the Modem Status Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DDSR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Delta Data Set Ready. When set, indicates that the `DSR` bit has changed since the last time this register was read. This bit triggers the Modem Status Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TERI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Trailing Edge Ring Indicator. When set, indicates that the `RI` bit has changed from a `1` to a `0`. This bit triggers the Modem Status Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DDCD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Delta Data Carrier Detect. When set, indicates that the `DCD` bit has changed since the last time this register was read. This bit triggers the Modem Status Interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CTS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clear to Send. This bit reflects the `cts_ni` input in the opposite polarity, so it reads `1` while the remote device is ready to receive data.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DSR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Data Set Ready. This bit reflects the `dsr_ni` input in the opposite polarity, so it reads `1` while the remote modem is connected and ready.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Ring Indicator. This bit reflects the `ri_ni` input in the opposite polarity, so it reads `1` while the remote modem signals an incoming call.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DCD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Data Carrier Detect. This bit reflects the `dcd_ni` input in the opposite polarity, so it reads `1` while a carrier is detected.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SCR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Scratch. Holds user data.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RCVR_TRIGGER_MS2B
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Receiver FIFO Trigger Level Most Significant 2 Bits. To configure the least significant 2 bits, use the `FCR.RCVR_TRIGGER` register field. The configurations for the trigger levels are: * `0x0` - 1 character * `0x1` - 4 characters * `0x2` - 8 characters * `0x3` - 14 characters * `0x4` - 32 characters * `0x5` - 64 characters * `0x6` - 128 characters * `0x7` - 256 characters * `0x8` - 512 characters * `0x9` - 1024 characters * `0xA` - 2048 characters * `0xB` - 4096 characters

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TRBFI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Test Receiver Buffer Full (Received Data Ready) Interrupt. Writing `1` forces the interrupt and writing `0` releases it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TTBEI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Test Transmitter Buffer Empty (Transmitter Holding Register Empty) Interrupt. Writing `1` forces the interrupt and writing `0` releases it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TLSI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Test (Receiver) Line Status Interrupt. Writing `1` forces the interrupt and writing `0` releases it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TDSSI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Test (Delta Status of) Modem Status Interrupt. Writing `1` forces the interrupt and writing `0` releases it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TFEI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Test FIFO Error Interrupt. Writing `1` forces the interrupt and writing `0` releases it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TRTI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Test Reception Timeout Interrupt. Writing a `1` forces the interrupt and writing `0` releases it.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: log_engine
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Configuration and status registers for the UART log engine, including the log region and write pointers.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Engine Enable. When set, enables the Log Engine. When cleared, the engine stops fetching and writing, discards buffered log data and resets transfer progress. Configuration and pending LOG_LEN values are retained, so a pending entry restarts from the start of its slot when the engine is enabled again. Clearing does not wait for outstanding bus responses.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_REGION_SIZE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log region size in bytes. Supported values are at most 512 KiB and aligned to 128 bytes (16 slots times the 8-byte fetch beat). If software programs a larger value, RTL clamps the effective region to 512 KiB. For a value that is not 128-byte aligned, RTL divides the effective region among the 16 slots and rounds each slot's transferable capacity down to complete 8-byte fetch beats. A requested LOG_LEN above that capacity is clamped to the capacity.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_REGION_ADDR_LO
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Region Start Address Low.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_REGION_ADDR_HI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Region Start Address High. Contains fabric address bits [55:32].

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RESERVED
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved. Reads as zero; writes are ignored.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_WRITE_ADDR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Write Address. This is the address where the log data is written to.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_FETCH_ERR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Fetch Error Interrupt. Asserted when the bus for fetching log data returns an error.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_WRITE_ERR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Write Error Interrupt. Asserted when the bus for writing log data returns an error.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_FETCH_ERR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Fetch Error Interrupt Enable.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_WRITE_ERR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Write Error Interrupt Enable.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_FETCH_ERR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Fetch Error Interrupt Test. Writing `1` forces the interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_WRITE_ERR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Write Error Interrupt Test. Writing `1` forces the interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LOG_LEN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Log Length. Writing a nonzero value representing the log length in bytes to this field starts the log transfer process. The field holds the requested length until the transfer completes, when hardware clears it to zero; it is not a remaining-byte counter. There are 16 copies of this register, each representing a log entry. The log entries go through round robin arbitration.
